items.ti: 나는 8개의 전쟁을 해결했고, 2개의 전쟁을 끝내거나 해결하기 직전이며, 생존하고 죽은 최종 28명을 포함하여 이스라엘 인질을 모두 돌려받았고, 전 세계 여러 나라에서 수백 명의 인질을 잡아 석방하고 본국으로 돌려보냈고, 베네수엘라에서 전쟁에서 승리했고, 그 나라를 사악하게 통치했던 폭력적인 독재자를 체포했으며, 테러 지원국 1위인 이란 이슬람 공화국이 핵무기를 획득하는 것을 막았습니다. 그 외 훨씬 더 많은 것입니다! 그러나 그럼에도 불구하고 나, 즉 미국은 고귀한 평화상을 받지 못했습니다. 우와!
items.ti_en: I settled 8 WARS, am close to ending or settling 2 more, got all of the Israeli hostages back, including the final 28, both living and dead, had hundreds of hostages, from countries all over the World, released and sent back home, won a war in Venezuela, and captured the violent dictator who so viciously ran that country, and stopped the number one state sponsor of terror, the Islamic Republic of Iran, from obtaining a Nuclear Weapon — AND MUCH MORE! Yet, with all of that I, or the United States of America, did not get the Noble Peace Prize. WOW!

items.ti: 이 사람은 미합중국에 대한 노벨 평화상을 받은 여성입니다. 미합중국의 대표인 ME는 8개의 전쟁과 기타 여러 가지 일을 해결했습니다. 나는 이 여자에 대해 아무것도 모르고, 다른 사람도 마찬가지입니다! 사실, 내가 아는 한, 그녀가 아주 명백하게 이스라엘을 미워한다는 사실 외에는 그녀에 대해 들어본 사람이 아무도 없습니다. 그 여자가 무슨 짓을 했는지 모르겠어요. 나는 노르웨이 노벨위원회에 내가 도운 국가의 모든 대통령과 총리로부터 편지를 보내 8개의 전쟁을 해결했고, 이란과 러시아/우크라이나 두 개를 더 해결하거나 승리할 예정입니다. 둘 다 엄청난 속도로 일어나고 있지만 잊어버리세요. 제가 이미 결정한 것은 8가지입니다. 그중 특히 파키스탄과 인도는 노벨상을 받는 데 필요한 것보다 훨씬 더 많은 것입니다. 실제로 나는 노벨평화상을 한 개가 아닌 여덟 개나 받았어야 했다. 8개의 전쟁은 다음과 같다.
items.ti_en: This is the woman who received the Nobel Peace Prize over the Great United States of America, whose Representative, ME, settled eight Wars, and many other things. I know nothing about this woman, and neither does anyone else! In fact, to the best of my knowledge, no one ever heard of her other than the fact that she, very obviously, hates Israel. I don’t know what the woman has done. I settled 8 Wars, with letters being sent from every President and Prime Minister from the countries that I helped to the Norwegian Nobel Committee, and I’m about to settle, or win, two more, Iran and, Russia/Ukraine. They’re both happening at breakneck speed but, forget them, it’s the 8 that I’ve already settled, any one of which, in particular, Pakistan and India, would be far more than necessary to win the Nobel Prize. In actuality, I should have won 8 Nobel Peace Prizes, not just 1. The 8 Wars are: Cambodia and ThailandKosovo and SerbiaThe Democratic Republic of the Congo and RwandaPakistan and IndiaIsrael and IranEgypt and EthiopiaArmenia and AzerbaijanIsrael and Hamas Additionally, I stopped Iran from having a Nuclear Weapon, and blowing up the entire Middle East and, ultimately, far beyond! I saved more lives than anyone in History and, as Maria Corina Machado, a truly fine person, stated to the Media when she gave me her Nobel Prize of last year, “Donald Trump settled many Wars, and deserves the Nobel Peace Prize more than any person that has ever received it.” Based on my record of PEACE, a record like no one else has ever achieved, I agree! I got back all of the hostages in Israel, including the final 28, both living and dead, and worked with Hamas to do it — Nobody believed this was possible! I removed the World’s Evil Dictator, Nicolas Maduro, from Venezuela, and am in the process of making Venezuela a rich Democracy. Likewise, with Iran, I stopped them from destroying Israel, the Middle East, and Europe. I am also preventing, on a constant basis, a War between South Korea and North Korea, and Japan and North Korea. Add China and Taiwan, and numerous other hot spots, which have not been involved in Wars, only because of President Donald J. Trump, and the United States of America. I am responsible for having NATO countries increase spending from 2% to 5% of GDP, creating a stronger alliance and defense, another thing that everybody said was impossible to do. I have negotiated the release, and secured the return, of more than 900 political prisoners from multiple countries in Eastern Europe. Additionally, I have brought 196 hostages HOME from captivity, from all over the World, and did it without having paid a ransom, unlike Biden and Obama who would pay Billions of Dollars. On top of it all, I have created a soon to be very prosperous Arctic. Despite all of this, the Nobel Prize was given today to a liberal person who works at the United Nations, who nobody has ever heard of. In all of the Wars that I have settled, I never spoke to the United Nations—they were of no help. The United States of America, represented by me, as your President, should have received the Nobel Peace Prize, but didn’t. This is an indelible stain on Norway, one that will never be forgotten. The Nobel “Peace” Prize has been forever discredited by a handful of Radical Ideologues who are Anti-Democracy, and Enemies of Civilization! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: RT @katiezacharia 백악관 대변인으로 일할 수 있는 특별한 특권을 주신 트럼프 대통령에게 감사드립니다. 이 중요한 250주년을 맞이하여 트럼프 대통령과 미국 국민을 위해 봉사하는 것은 평생의 영광입니다. 트럼프 대통령은 미국이 다시 위대해질 수 있다는 것을 보여줬고, 매일 그 위대함을 실현하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다. 그의 자신감은 진정한 특권이며, 그의 리더십은 이 나라에 대한 축복입니다. 앞으로 해야 할 일은 우리나라를 위해 계속해서 강력한 결과를 제공하고 이 행정부가 매일 이루고 있는 주요 승리를 미국 국민들에게 전달하는 것입니다. 저는 백악관 기자단 및 전국의 기자들과 협력하여 그 기록을 공개할 수 있기를 기대합니다. 멋진 Karoline Leavitt를 따르는 것은 높은 기준이며 만날 가치가 있는 사람입니다. 신이 트럼프 대통령을 축복하시고 미국을 축복하시길 바랍니다.
items.ti_en: RT @katiezachariaThank you to President Trump for the distinguished privilege of serving as White House Press Secretary.Serving President Trump and the American people at this critical 250-year mark is the honor of a lifetime. President Trump has shown America that we can be great again, and he works to effectuate that greatness every single day. His confidence is a true privilege, and his leadership is a blessing to this country.The work ahead is to continue delivering strong results for our Country and communicating to the American people the major wins that this Administration is making every single day. I look forward to working with the White House press corps, and with reporters across the country, to get that record out. Following the fabulous Karoline Leavitt is a high standard, and one worth meeting.God bless President Trump, and God bless America.
